definitions.gloss: country living; rural life; life in the countryside
definitions.explanation: Living in a rural area, away from cities. Often used when discussing the lifestyle choice of moving to or living in the countryside.

examples.japanese: {田舎暮|いなかぐ}らしに{憧|あこが}れる。
{定年後|ていねんご}に{田舎暮|いなかぐ}らしを{始|はじ}めた。
examples.english: After retirement, I started living in the countryside.

examples.japanese: {田舎暮|いなかぐ}らしは{自然|しぜん}が{豊|ゆた}かだが、{買|か}い{物|もの}には{不便|ふべん}なこともある。
examples.english: Country living has abundant nature, but shopping can be inconvenient.

notes:
Composed of {田舎|いなか} (countryside, rural area) + {暮|く}らし (living, life). A compound that has become increasingly popular as more Japanese people consider relocating from cities to rural areas, especially since the COVID-19 pandemic enabled remote work.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {田舎暮|いなかぐ}らしに{憧|あこが}れる: to dream of country life
- {田舎暮|いなかぐ}らしを{始|はじ}める: to start country living
- {田舎暮|いなかぐ}らしの{魅力|みりょく}: the appeal of rural life
- {田舎暮|いなかぐ}らし{体験|たいけん}: rural life experience (trial programs)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {都会暮|とかいぐ}らし: city living (the opposite)
- {移住|いじゅう}: migration, relocation (the act of moving, often to the countryside)
- {帰農|きのう}: returning to farming (a more specific form of rural relocation)
